title: Additive gameplay-specific IndexedDB atomic writer with request and sequence checks
purpose: Prove one-transaction sequence, Lamport, request replay and event uniqueness for prepared gameplay events without reopening frozen I08/I10 or mutating existing saves.
non_goals: No I08/I07/I10/I12 freeze reopen, no modifications to existing IndexedDB store or database schema
No gameplay UI activation, automatic save migration, I12 evidence/status update, merge or release
compatibility: Additive infrastructure module. Existing IndexedDB schema and public I08 adapter remain unchanged. No bootstrap/UI import until central writer ownership is established.
security: Single readwrite transaction for history validation and append, global IndexedDB primary key, request replay and Lamport/sequence guards, full abort on failure, no mutation of old saves. Existing generic writer can bypass gameplay checks and is not yet retired.
test_plan: real Chromium 15-case IndexedDB concurrency/abort/reopen smoke in GitHub CI
I08/I10 regression and prerelease matrix audit; repository Quality remains red until I12 checkpoint rebind
rollback: Revert this additive branch. No production data, I08 schema, I10 UI or frozen evidence were changed.
